metadata.indication: First-line extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer, with four induction cycles followed by atezolizumab maintenance.
metadata.safety_note: Induction cytotoxic rules require the active phase. Omitted phase returns a review warning for actionable cytotoxic values. Atezolizumab immune rules require relevant attribution and do not diagnose immune hepatitis/nephritis from isolated laboratory values. Route alternatives must be prescribed explicitly.

metadata.schedule_summary: Induction: atezolizumab and carboplatin on Day 1, with etoposide on Days 1–3, repeated every 21 days for up to four cycles. Maintenance: carboplatin and etoposide stop; atezolizumab alone continues every 21 days while appropriate. The fourth cycle ends about 12 weeks after starting if there are no delays; maintenance has no fixed total duration in this regimen.

indications.description: First-line treatment of adult patients with extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer.

treatment_phases.label: Induction · up to four cycles
treatment_phases.duration_text: Four 21-day cycles unless progression or unacceptable toxicity; confirm IV/SC atezolizumab and IV versus IV/PO etoposide schedule.

dose.value: 1200 mg IV OR 1875 mg SC; select prescribed formulation

administration.route: IV or SC — select the prescribed formulation
administration.notes: IV: 250 mL sodium chloride 0.9%, first over 60 minutes, later 30 minutes if tolerated. SC: 1875 mg over 7 minutes into alternating thighs; ≥2.5 cm from previous site, avoid red/bruised/tender/hard skin; do not give residual tubing hold-up. These are distinct formulations and doses, never mg-for-mg substitutes.

500 mL glucose 5% over 30 minutes. Calvert dose=AUC×(GFR+25), GFR capped at 125 mL/min. Measured GFR preferred; assess obesity/low creatinine and method-specific limits. No automatic dose computed here.

1000 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 60 minutes on Days 1–3. Alternative MUST be explicitly prescribed: Day 1 IV 100 mg/m², then PO 100 mg/m² TWICE DAILY on Days 2–3, empty stomach, 50/100 mg capsules. This reference IV row must not be read as the oral dose.

treatment_phases.label: Maintenance · atezolizumab only
treatment_phases.duration_text: Atezolizumab alone every 21 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity. A separate 1680 mg IV/28-day maintenance schedule may be considered under NCCP00593; requires explicit prescribing, not conversion by this suite.
